services.desc: Taekwon-Do is not just a sport, it's a Way of Life. It is a valuable life skill with lots of awesome benefits for the practitioner. Although focused on physical fighting skills, Taekwon-Do also teaches discipline, allowing us to improve our body, spirit and life. TRY it out. No matter your age, you have nothing to lose and everything to gain towards a better YOU. Our Instructors are Internationally Certified Members of the International Taekwon-Do Federation. We are members of the Canadian Taekwon-Do Federation International and the ITF of British Columbia Train like a CHAMPION! Join DSA Taekwon-Do's team of excellent competitors. Though we train for defense, competitions test our skills
